svg.title: Wendmere · King’s Keep · Princess’s Tower

a.title: A low market street crosses beneath a clock bridge. Hop cart → awning → bell balcony; the well stays in the social center.
Forge yard, armor gallery and arcane loft each have a working ground entrance. Continuous awning tops make a second shopping route.
Garden stairs weave through low herb beds, a glass mixing room and suspended drying racks. A rope returns from the sun terrace.
Six distinct stations sit around an open sparring court. Crates, balance beams and climb ropes form an optional loop above safe instruction space.
A generous hearth room anchors the inn. Tables lead to the serving hatch; a stair rises to bunk balconies and a luggage loft.
Terraced farmland becomes ivy-covered masonry. Cart roofs and fruit walls build toward the guardian court, with a clearly marked turn-back landing.
Two gate towers flank a central portcullis. Walk below or cross the battlement; side doors keep the barracks and service court distinct.
The recruit court remains open beneath bunks and equipment galleries. Shield racks and footlockers make low jump steps toward the captain balcony.
Separate the hot forge from the food court with a loading lift. Flour sacks, worktables and the hoist platform join the upper service galleries.
The procession floor faces a raised dais. A pair of side galleries reach the Archive and sealed tower without forcing visitors across the king’s audience.
A broad audience floor ends at the oath dais. The council table and diplomatic balcony create quiet secondary routes around the throne.
Stacks form stepping furniture below a brass archive bridge. Reading tables, rolling ladders and treasury cages define separate working rooms.
Enter at the foot of the tower. Climb around the bell counterweight through stores, the keeper’s room and the ringing gallery. The upper door continues into Winding Stair.

Alternating stair flights wrap the central shaft. Window seats and lamplighter shelves punctuate the ascent; maintenance ladders and a bell rope offer shorter routes. Reach the Solar through the highest door.

Arrive beneath the private rooms, then climb past the library and ward table to Lyra’s sunlit chamber. A final stair reaches the telescope beneath the glazed dome. Return through the lower tower door.

svg.text: Click a place to open its complete side-scroll SVG. Every drawn road is a reciprocal portal connection.
Outer village: shared · Stronghold / story: Light allegiance · Story doors also retain their authored quest or tide checks.
